text: El Presidente simulator 4 is a fine city building game with socio-economical influences, good music and tons of cheesy humor that reminds people of Red Alert 2 and 3. The reference to real politicians (Nixon, Thatcher, Arafat,...) holds a fine line between criticism and just plain humor when you see the world from a Banana republic point of view. Also Penultimo is more loyal to you than any dog. You can be a capitalist, a commie, a dictator or the nicest person to ever roamed the ways of politics, it's all up to you, but each decision has consequences, which is one of the most important and compelling arguments you can make to grant this game the thumbs up. Plays well, will easily take 50+ hours of your time in campaign mode. Well make that 100+, which means that if you're into the whole city-society building thing this is insane value for money. Totally recommended.
